content:
customer-james: Hey team — after we migrated our workspace into the new org yesterday, our monthly token balance shows 0 and all requests are getting 429s. Billing UI still shows ~120k credits left. Can you help?

linda (Support): Sorry about that — can you share your org_id and one recent request_id that got a 429? Also which region/tenant?

customer-james: org_id=org_7a9f, region=us-west-2, recent request_id=01GZ3M9P4R9T0ABCDEF2

linda (Support): Got it — forwarding to eng oncall and billing. @ingrid @sam can you take a look?

support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3287 (quota-migration-anomaly). Assigned to ingrid.

ingrid (Eng Oncall): Thanks — checking logs now. Do you see the 429 body containing "monthly_quota_exhausted" or the generic rate-limit message?

customer-james: The 429 body is: {"error":"quota_exceeded","detail":"monthly_token_bucket_empty"} — same as before but it happened mid-cycle after migration.

ingrid (Eng Oncall): That helps. Two quick hypotheses: 1) migration produced a duplicate allocation which caused immediate consumption during background reconciliation, or 2) the bucket got clamped to zero due to a negative adjustment. Can you confirm whether any long-running streaming jobs were active during the migration?

customer-james: We did have a few streaming debug sessions open (websocket clients) but nothing large — maybe 2 concurrent sessions.

sam (Billing Ops): I'm seeing the same on billing side: ledger shows ~120k credits for the billing account, but tenant-level window has a pending_adjustment of -119977 which drove the effective bucket to 0. That adjustment was created at migration time by the workspace-merge job.

linda (Support): Ok that explains the mismatch between UI billing balance and tenant visible bucket. What's the mitigation plan?

ingrid (Eng Oncall): Short term: we can push a temporary credit top-up to the tenant to unblock immediately. Long term: we need to re-run the reconciliation job with a clamp to prevent negative pending_adjustment entries and fix the merge logic. I'll outline repro and fix steps here.

ingrid (Eng Oncall): Repro steps we used locally:
```
# simulate merge causing duplicate allocations
INSERT INTO tenant_allocations(tenant_id, allocation) VALUES ('org_7a9f', 120000);
-- merge job runs and applies an adjustment that double-subtracts
CALL workspace_merge('org_7a9f', 'team_old');
-- reconciliation computes pending_adjustment = -120000 (buggy)
SELECT compute_effective_bucket('org_7a9f');
```

ingrid (Eng Oncall): Fix (patch) summary: 1) clamp pending_adjustment >= -total_allocated; 2) add a safety check so effective_bucket = max(0, floor(billing_balance + pending_adjustment)); 3) add unit test for workspace merges with overlapping allocations.

sam (Billing Ops): For immediate unblock I applied a one-off tenant_credit grant: +120000 tokens (temp_grant id tg_2026_3287) at 2171112500, expires in 48 hours unless we confirm reconciliation. That should stop 429s while we run the safer reconciliation.

customer-james: Thanks — I'm still seeing a few 429s on the next minute, but most requests succeed. Will monitor and report if anything continues.

linda (Support): Monitoring: we can also rate-limit streaming reconnects from the client side to reduce burst consumption. Recommend client backoff 2s -> 10s jitter for reconnections until cleared.

customer-james: Copy that. We'll add backoff. Appreciate the quick help.

ingrid (Eng Oncall): We're scheduling the safer re-run now — job queued 2171112750. Plan: re-compute effective buckets for org_7a9f, write a corrected pending_adjustment, and record an audit row. Expected finish ~2171112950. I'll post results.

support-bot: Job queued: quota-recompute-org_7a9f (job_512).

ingrid (Eng Oncall): Job finished 2171112948 — recomputed effective_bucket -> 120000, pending_adjustment corrected to -23 (rounding/past usage). No negative clamps required. Audit: audit_2026_3287 created.

sam (Billing Ops): Confirmed ledger and tenant view now match. I removed the temporary grant tg_2026_3287 (it was unused).

customer-james: Confirmed — no more 429s and UI shows correct token balance. Thanks everyone!

linda (Support): Closing ticket in 24h if no regressions. Notes for postmortem: migration path allowed pending_adjustment to be outside expected bounds; immediate fix: clamp and add pre-check; follow-up: add alert for large negative pending_adjustments during migration windows.

ingrid (Eng Oncall): I'll open a PR with the clamp and test, target deploy in next patch. PR link: https://github.internal/redwood/repo/pull/3456 (will update once merged).

customer-james: Great — thanks all :thumbsup:
